shapeSummary: ServoBlock approximation: 40x63x3 servo mounting plate with four Ø4 slots, 43x42x3 bearing plate, four 6 mm square corner posts on a 32 mm square pattern, Ø32 hub boss on top, Ø14 central bore through all, and four Ø4 through holes on the 32 mm square pattern. Overall about 43 x 63 x 49.5 mm, with the hub axis along Z and the bottom at Y=0.
warnings: No scraped dimensions were available; sizes are estimated from the drawing and the given bounds.
The 49.5 mm depth may include the servo envelope; the servo itself is not modeled.
The hub's alternating threaded and through hole ring, the spline and the hex or D-bore detail are omitted because their sizes are not stated.
Plate and flange thicknesses, post sizes, the hub center height (21 mm) and the slot positions are guesses.
The side flanges and bearings are simplified into corner posts and a single bearing plate.
